notablePrerequisites:
A player has at least six cards in hand, not including Windfall if its in your hand.
You control at least seven lands, of which one can tap to produce {U} and another can tap to produce {G}.
If Windfall is in your graveyard, you have three other cards in your graveyard excluding it and Splendid Reclamation if it's in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing at least seven lands, adding {5}{G}{U}.
Cast Windfall either from your hand by paying {2}{U}, or from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{U} and exiling three nonland cards except Splendid Reclamation from your graveyard, causing each player to discard their hand and draw cards equal to the greatest number a player discarded this way.
Cast Splendid Reclamation from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {3}{G} and exiling three nonland cards except Windfall from your graveyard, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.
Depending on the number of cards in a player's hand and/or in your graveyard when Windfall resolves, you may be able to omit casting it during an iteration.
